recommendation: Keep PCP as a core compound with a targeted historical discovery backfill; exclude standalone cannabinoid research from the core; retain substantive core-drug comparisons/interactions; reserve comprehensive cannabinoid coverage for a separate explicit expansion.
earlier_explanation_correction: Use for psychedelic purposes alone is too broad to define this corpus consistently. State selected compound families and explicit project exclusions.
cannabis_terms_role: All cannabis mentions in these saved queries were cannabis/marijuana use disorder, a potential treatment target.
pcp_query_caution: Current generated aliases contain bare PCP. Review/disambiguate primary-care and Pneumocystis meanings before executing; preserve phencyclidine full-name/controlled-vocabulary coverage.
size_interpretation: Raw PubMed count checks before full eligibility, deduplication or overlap with the graph; neither additions nor included studies nor estimates of search recall.
coverage_claim: Absence of dedicated queries demonstrates a coverage risk, not the proportion missing. Incidental retrieval and shared drug/class indexing may capture substantial literature. No overall recall measured.
next_steps_if_approved: Record the finite core scope and cannabinoid exclusion explicitly in methods.
Backfill PCP historically in PubMed and OpenAlex using existing discovery workflow and unambiguous aliases.
Deduplicate, title/abstract-screen only new candidates with Luna, recover accessible full texts only after inclusion, and extract through the existing workflow.
